# HTTP API specification

Build an HTTP JSON API. It must start with `node server.js` and listen on the
port in the `PORT` environment variable, defaulting to 3000.

All responses are JSON with `content-type: application/json`.

## Endpoints

`GET /health`
  200 with body `{"status": "ok"}`

`GET /todos`
  200 with a JSON array of every todo. Empty array when there are none.

`POST /todos`
  Body: `{"title": "<string>"}`
  201 with the created todo: `{"id": <number>, "title": "<string>", "done": false}`
  Ids are numbers and are unique.

`GET /todos/:id`
  200 with that todo, or 404 with body `{"error": "not found"}`

`POST /todos/:id/done`
  200 with the todo, now `"done": true`. The change persists for later reads.
  404 with `{"error": "not found"}` if the id does not exist.

Todos are kept in memory. No database, no persistence across restarts.

tasks.statement: Build the HTTP JSON API described in SPEC.md. Read SPEC.md first. Create server.js and anything else you need, so that `node server.js` starts a server implementing every endpoint exactly as specified. Do not modify SPEC.md. You may install dependencies with npm if you want them, or use only the Node standard library.
